## Behavior and motivation

Describe the problem and observable before/after behavior. Link issues and any RFC
or ADR. Distinguish implemented behavior from proposed design.

## Validation

List exact commands run and their results, plus relevant manual checks. State what
could not run and why. For documentation, check examples and links; for snapshots,
explain every intentional change.

## Compatibility

Describe source, CLI, configuration, diagnostic protocol, dependency/MSRV, and
security implications as relevant. Include migration notes for breaking changes.

## AI involvement

Name the tools/models used and what they generated or reviewed, or write “none”.
The submitting human is accountable for the complete contribution.

- [ ] I reviewed the change and can explain its behavior and licensing.
- [ ] I disclosed AI involvement, or explicitly stated that none was used.
- [ ] My validation report describes checks actually run; no fabricated passes.
- [ ] I reviewed every snapshot diff, or this change has no snapshot updates.
- [ ] I documented compatibility/migration and changelog impact, or explained why none applies.
- [ ] I linked an RFC/ADR and named maintainer review where semantics/security require it, or explained why not applicable.
- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits and is suitable for a squash commit.
